How to read it

  • ee / eausually becomes i
  • vis English v, never Spanish b
  • shcovers ship and measure
  • hbecomes Spanish j
  • j / soft gbecomes Spanish y
  • this the English sound in think
  • ris English r, never tapped or rolled
  • silent echanges the earlier vowel

Special sound rules

Spanish reading rules handle the rest. These conventions preserve English sounds that need special treatment; Personal starts with these defaults.

English sound Example Standard
/v/veryv
/θ/thinkth
/ʃ/shipsh
/ʒ/measuresh
/ɹ/redr

English spelling does not reliably encode pronunciation, so this uses CMU pronunciation data, explicit exceptions, and fallback rules for unknown words.
